QuerySandboxes.limit: Number of results per page, range 1-100, default 100.
QuerySandboxes.nextToken: Pagination cursor from the previous response; empty for the first request.
QuerySandboxes.sandboxIds: List of sandbox instance IDs; multiple values within the group are OR-combined.
QuerySandboxes.imagePaths: List of actual image paths; multiple values within the group are OR-combined.
QuerySandboxes.metadata: Key-value filter for metadata; multiple conditions are AND-combined.
QuerySandboxes.state: List of sandbox states; valid values: running, paused, killing, killed.
